properties.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
properties.observation: Perseverance touchdown site, informally named Octavia E. Butler Landing by the science team.
properties.why_it_matters: Start point of the mission and a natural EVA start/return point on flat crater-floor terrain.
properties.source: NASA/JPL PIA24483, Welcome to Octavia E. Butler Landing
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 3_0 (sol 13), last waypoint on or before sol 0; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)

properties.name: Rochette (Montdenier, Montagnac cores)
properties.observation: Site of Perseverance's first two rock cores, Montdenier and Montagnac, from the crater-floor rock called Rochette (basalt or basaltic sandstone in NASA's sample table).
properties.instrument: Sampling and Caching System; PIXL; SHERLOC
properties.why_it_matters: First cored rocks of the mission: igneous crater-floor context for the walk.
properties.source: NASA Science, A Historic Moment: Perseverance collects its first two rock samples
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 7_0 (sol 180), last waypoint on or before sol 194; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)

properties.name: Brac outcrop, Seitah (Salette, Coulettes cores)
properties.observation: Olivine cumulate rock in the Seitah formation; cores Salette (sol 262) and Coulettes (sol 271).
properties.instrument: PIXL; SHERLOC; SuperCam; Sampling and Caching System
properties.why_it_matters: Olivine-rich igneous rock of the Seitah unit: direct target for goal G2.
properties.source: Weiss et al. 2024, Earth and Space Science (sol table); Liu et al. 2022, Science (olivine cumulate)
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 8_0 (sol 248), last waypoint on or before sol 262; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)

properties.name: Issole, Seitah (Robine core)
properties.observation: Olivine cumulate rock in South Seitah; core Robine.
properties.why_it_matters: Second Seitah sampling site: compare olivine-rich rock along the walk.
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 9_0 (sol 286), last waypoint on or before sol 298; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)

properties.name: Skinner Ridge, delta front (Swift Run, Skyland cores)
properties.observation: First sedimentary cores of the mission, Swift Run (sol 490) and Skyland (sol 495), at the base of the western fan; the rover arrived on sol 477.
properties.instrument: Sampling and Caching System; Mastcam-Z; SuperCam
properties.why_it_matters: Layered sedimentary rock at the fan front: the base of the delta stratigraphy for goal G3.
properties.source: Bosak et al. 2024, AGU Advances, Astrobiological potential of rocks at a sedimentary fan front
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 26_1004 (sol 477), last waypoint on or before sol 490; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)

properties.name: Wildcat Ridge, delta front (Hazeltop, Bearwallow cores)
properties.observation: Fine-grained, sulfate-bearing mudstone; SHERLOC recorded the mission's most abundant organic detections to that date, spatially correlated with sulfate minerals. Cores Hazeltop (sol 509) and Bearwallow (sol 516).
properties.instrument: SHERLOC; PIXL; Sampling and Caching System
properties.why_it_matters: Organic molecules in a lake-deposited mudstone make it a priority biosignature target (organics with sulfates, not carbonate).
properties.source: NASA/JPL, NASA's Perseverance Rover Investigates Geologically Rich Mars Terrain
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 26_1222 (sol 502), last waypoint on or before sol 509; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)

properties.name: Amalik outcrop, delta front (Shuyak core)
properties.why_it_matters: Another layer of the fan-front sediments, a short walk from Skinner Ridge and Wildcat Ridge.
properties.source: NASA Mars 2020 mission status: Perseverance activities at Amalik outcrop
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 29_0 (sol 565), last waypoint on or before sol 574; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)

properties.name: Three Forks sample depot
properties.observation: Ten sample tubes left on the surface between sols 653 and 690 for possible future return to Earth.
properties.why_it_matters: Mapped depot of cached samples near the base of the delta: a known, flat waypoint.
properties.source: NASA, NASA's Perseverance Rover Completes Mars Sample Depot
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 32_148 (sol 652), last waypoint on or before sol 653; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)

properties.name: Berea, upper fan (Melyn core)
properties.observation: Sandstone on the upper fan; core Melyn, the first sample after the depot was completed.
properties.why_it_matters: Upper part of the fan: compare with the fan-front layers to read the delta's history.
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 37_0 (sol 736), last waypoint on or before sol 749; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)

properties.name: Hans Amundsen Memorial Workspace, margin unit (Pelican Point core)
properties.observation: Core Pelican Point from the margin unit along the inner crater rim; orbital spectra map carbonate-bearing rocks along this crater margin.
properties.instrument: Sampling and Caching System (sample); MRO CRISM (orbital carbonate mapping)
properties.why_it_matters: Marginal carbonates are a biosignature target for goal G1.
properties.source: NASA Mars Rock Samples (core); Zastrow & Glotch 2021, GRL (margin carbonates from orbit)
properties.measured_or_derived: measured (rover localization and published sample records)
properties.position_basis: Perseverance localization RMC 45_0 (sol 911), last waypoint on or before sol 921; accurate to the rover's workspace (a few metres)
